name: Exide Industries Ltd
title: Exide Industries Ltd - 500086 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue +9.4% YoY with gross margin down ~90bp to 30.1% on a Rs 150 crore commodity hit, offset by cost control and 3-4 rounds of price hikes totalling ~5-6% plus ~3% in April; Rs 1,400 crore FY27 lithium-ion capex with no cell revenue yet.

utilisation.quote: the Company continued to ramp up production, leading to higher capacity utilization, better absorption of fixed costs

capex.quote: we have already got a Board approval and this has been announced in the past of investing Rs. 1400 crore in the Fiscal Year '27

triggers.label: Price hikes ~5-6% plus ~3% April
triggers.quote: we have taken increases which maybe amounts to about, let's say, about 5% to 6%

triggers.label: Auto OEM +25% YoY, second straight quarter
triggers.quote: auto OEM business recorded its second consecutive quarter of (+25%) year-on-year growth

triggers.label: Lithium-ion capex Rs 1,400 cr in FY27
triggers.quote: investing Rs. 1400 crore in the Fiscal Year '27, which is a mix of both CAPEX as well as the OPEX working capital

triggers.label: Sulfur Rs 15 to Rs 75/kg
triggers.quote: sulfuric acid costs have gone to Rs. 75 April exit, compared to Rs. 15 in the beginning of the year

guidance.value: high single-digit to early double-digit growth
guidance.quote: I would still believe that the core business at this situation has a potential to do at least a high single -digit to early-double digit growth
investing Rs. 1400 crore in the Fiscal Year '27
Let us operate at 85% utilization with 90% yield.

red_flags.label: Gross margin compression 90bp QoQ
red_flags.quote: So, the gross margin, if you see, has come down by about 90 basis points

red_flags.label: Non-current investments fell ~Rs 850 cr (MTM)
red_flags.quote: non-current investments have fallen by about Rs. 850 crores

evasions.quote: But the time to announce that has not come.
This is still not in public. Could be, but I am not commenting on this
I think Aditya, perhaps this is a little not in public domain.
